extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed repair of the primary Table 2 antimicrobial activity data; only the MIC column is represented as activity evidence.

assay_conditions.peptide_material: synthetic mature RbLEAP-2 peptide, >90% purity, containing the source-reported Cys74-Cys85 and Cys80-Cys90 disulfide pairings
assay_conditions.peptide_solvent: 0.5% DMSO diluted stepwise with Mueller-Hinton broth
assay_conditions.inoculum: 5 x 10^5 cfu/mL mixed 1:1 with peptide dilution
assay_conditions.incubation: 12 h shaking; table-specific strain temperature recorded separately
assay_conditions.readout: OD540 after incubation; MIC is the lowest peptide concentration inhibiting bacterial growth

supporting_locators.role: table header: Bacterial strain / Gram / degrees C / MIC (μg/ml)

activity_records.review_notes: Temperature and Gram columns were separated from the MIC endpoint during worker-6 repair; no temperature value is retained as an MIC row.
